title: Boss Challenge: Marathon Medic
summary: Follow a runner through a half marathon, reading heart rate, breathing, temperature and sweat, and explain how the body's systems respond.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: interpreting data about interacting systems (Criteria A and C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 9: Life Processes in Animals
Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Transportation in Animals and Plants

objectives: I can interpret data on heart rate, breathing, sweating and temperature.
I can explain how the body's systems work together during exercise.
misconceptions: Each body system works on its own.
